name: 92804 · Anaheim, CA
findings: ZIP 92804 (Anaheim) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92804 (Anaheim) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 67 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
